title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 2: What happened this week?

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Hier soir, j'ai terminé mon devoir et j'ai préparé mon exposé.
steps.question: What did the speaker prepare?
steps.explain: The speaker says j'ai préparé mon exposé.

steps.fr: La semaine dernière, nous avons réservé une visite guidée pour samedi.
steps.question: When did they book the tour?
steps.explain: The first words are la semaine dernière.

steps.fr: J'ai préparé le devoir pendant une heure parce que le cours a commencé plus tard.
steps.question: Why did the person work on the assignment for an hour?
steps.explain: The speaker says the class started later.

steps.fr: Avant-hier, j'ai emprunté un dictionnaire. Hier matin, j'ai terminé le devoir.
steps.question: What did the speaker finish yesterday morning?
steps.explain: The second sentence says the speaker finished the assignment yesterday morning.

steps.fr: Heureusement, nous avons trouvé le bon bureau au bon moment.
steps.question: How did the speakers feel about finding the office?
steps.explain: Heureusement signals that finding the office was fortunate.
